qualification: local A05.3 reliability isolation; not A05.3 closure, performance acceptance, cross-host, G1-G5, or release qualification

candidate.acceptedBoundary: The production PC machine permits same-tier direct chaining only within the Tier-one compiler ABI. Legacy baseline and optimizing blocks cannot initiate direct links, the existing compiler-ABI gate prevents cross-tier links, and the generated IBTC and shadow-return stack remain absent.
candidate.behavioralIntent: Isolate Tier-one-source direct edges after the legacy-only source class passed twice and the earlier combined direct-source candidate failed one of two runs.
candidate.productionFinding: Two runs of the exact same hashed release runner passed all seven authenticated workloads and powered off. Both exercised Tier-one direct chaining and recorded zero IBTC and shadow-return activity. This accepts the isolated Tier-one source class as a bounded production reliability boundary, but does not overturn the combined direct-source rejection or establish whether coexistence, layout, timing, or another intermittent defect caused it.

verification.focused: 37 tests in two suites passed: three predictor-boundary regressions plus DoryPCDirectKernelMachineTests.
verification.deterministicAggregate: 1,558 tests in 179 suites passed with test parallelism disabled.

comparison.finding: Legacy-only and Tier-one-only direct-source configurations each passed two bounded exact-binary runs. The combined configuration previously passed once and failed once, so it remains rejected and no sole-cause claim is made.

retainedBaseline.reason: The accepted Tier-one-only boundary excludes legacy direct sources, the IBTC, and shadow returns, so its approximately 36.45-percent bypass share cannot replace the broader accepted enabled-path measurement.

disposition.reason: Production retains Tier-one-source direct chaining as the higher-avoidance independently accepted boundary. A05.3 remains open for combined-source diagnosis, independent IBTC and shadow-return reintroduction, and a final enabled path exceeding 95-percent dispatcher avoidance.

limitations: Two passing local runs are a bounded reliability check, not cross-host qualification or proof that every intermittent failure has been eliminated.
The result does not overturn the one-of-two combined direct-source failure or distinguish coexistence from binary-layout, timing, or another intermittent correlated defect.
The measured 36.43-36.47-percent within-run avoidance is below the strict A05.3 performance threshold.
The raw diagnostic receipts remain in /private/tmp; this checked-in record binds their hashes and selected counters.
